notes.rationale: 'pok' (antaimoni, blakpela kala bilong ai) vs KJV 'fair colours' vs Geneva 'carbuncle' — Hebrew literally 'in antimony', a setting/cement metaphor.

notes.subject: בפוך
notes.rationale: Buk onli hia (wantaim ekodah long ves 12) dispela tok bilong kala i kamap.

notes.subject: to Yerusalayim/Sion
notes.rationale: Direct address to the afflicted, storm-tossed city; הנה ('lukim') summons attention.

translation: Yu pinis, ol i pundaunim yu, win bikpela i sokim yu i go ivi, i no gat wanpela i komfortim yu — lukim, mi putim ol ston bilong yu wantaim pok, na mi stapim fandesen bilong yu long ol sapaia.
